source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Electrical - Body and Chassis, p.12-51

procedures.title: Wiper relay switch-latch and terminal board: install (Type C depressed park wiper)
steps: Resolder the leads to the terminal board as needed (see figure 77 in the manual).
Slide the terminal board into the housing, placing the resistor lead as in figure 78 in the manual.
Resolder the leads to the relay switch as needed.
Set the relay-switch in the housing.
notes: Figure 77 wiring: red relay lead to terminal No. 1; tan lead to the same relay switch terminal as the red coil lead; black with pink stripe also shown.
